items.headline: US envoys and Putin agree to keep Ukraine peace talks going
items.summary: US special envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner flew to Moscow, and both sides agreed to continue talks on ending the Russia-Ukraine war.

items.headline: Iran threatens wider war as Israel reportedly readies strikes
items.summary: Israeli media say the security cabinet ordered the military to prepare for possible strikes on Iran. Tehran warned it would take the war beyond the region if attacked.

items.headline: Mississippi elects its first Black senator since 1874
items.summary: Democrat Scott Colom won the closely watched US Senate race in Mississippi.

items.headline: UK economy grows 0.7% in the third quarter
items.summary: Growth picked up from 0.5% in the previous quarter, led by services. September alone grew 0.2%, beating forecasts of no growth.

items.headline: FTSE 100 edges up as Burberry jumps 8%
items.summary: The index rose 0.25% to 10,863.09, helped by strong results from Burberry and 3i, despite a dip in the afternoon on Nvidia news.
items.source: Yahoo Finance and BBN Times, 12 Nov

items.headline: Nvidia's Jensen Huang resigns as chief executive
items.summary: Finance chief Colette Kress is interim CEO after an investigation into Huang widened. The shares fell about 12% at the open, after a week that has wiped more than $600bn off the company's value.
items.source: AI Frontier Daily and Nvidia, 12 Nov

items.headline: United Airlines blocks AI agents from booking flights
items.summary: United is stopping unauthorised AI agents from making bookings, as more people try letting AI shop for them.

items.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen for fast coding and agents
items.summary: The model costs $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens, and Google says it finishes tasks 2.5 times faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash.

items.headline: Anthropic bars Claude use from mainland China
items.summary: From 12 November, Claude can't be used from mainland China or by companies controlled from there. Suspicious accounts face ID checks and can be closed.
